_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The Markdown file editor keeps Monaco's delete-line shortcut while the editor has focus. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding keys.md, whose lines are "# Keep", "Remove this line" and "Keep this too". To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open keys.md. 3. Focus the editor input. 4. Press "Home" with the Control modifier. 5. Press "ArrowDown". 6. Press "K" with the modifiers Control+Shift (Monaco's delete line). 7. The modal's ".view-lines" should come to not contain "Remove this line". 8. The modal must hold exactly 0 regions named "Markdown preview". 9. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt. 10. The preview should be visible. 11. Press "K" with the modifiers Control+Shift. 12. The modal's ".monaco-editor" should be visible. 13. Its ".view-lines" must still not contain "Remove this line".
